meta.warm_vs_cold_correction: BASE-01's recorded native watermark of 360 (both native and native_nodevtools) was a WARM-CACHE figure, not a clean-build figure, despite BASE-01's own meta.note asserting every figure came from a clean build. 124-RESEARCH.md independently discovered and this plan independently re-confirmed: a cold build of the IDENTICAL unmerged tree (Phase 123's tip, byte-identical compiled surface to BASE-01's measurement) measures 456, not 360 -- Phase 123 touched zero firmware source or test/ files, so the discrepancy is a measurement-procedure artifact (pio's build-directory reuse across invocations), never a code change. On the now-landed, post-v1.23 tree measured by this plan: native COLD=1166 / WARM=998; native_nodevtools COLD=1166 / WARM=998 (both envs agree, as they did pre-landing). The new third env, native_pinmap_provisional (added by Plan 124-08), measures COLD=138 / WARM=0 -- a different cold/warm ratio than the two pinned envs because it compiles only 1 suite (vs 17), so its warm re-run's auto-regenerated Unity test-runner recompile touches none of the redefinition-prone shim files that the two pinned envs' warm re-runs still touch. Mechanism behind the +638 (warm) / +710 (cold) increase from pre-landing to post-landing on the two pinned envs: the landed include/rurp_platform_compat.h now defines the program-memory macros (pgm_read_ptr, strncpy_P, strncmp_P, sprintf_P, strcmp_P, sprintf_P, strncmp_P, PGM_P, F -- six new names beyond BASE-01's original eight, contributed by 780a3fb), and ArduinoFake's own pgmspace.h then redefines every one of them across roughly 27 more translation units than before. This is benign, identical-purpose redefinition -- not damage -- but it is not zero, and check_build_warnings.py cannot tell the difference between a benign redefinition and a real new warning class; it can only count. All three total_watermark/macro_redefinition figures recorded in warnings.native below are therefore the COLD figure for that env, per the mechanical reason stated in warnings.note. A future reader who wants to LOWER any of these three watermarks must re-measure cold first, in this exact rm -rf + single-invocation sequence, and never guess a new figure down from prose.
